Since 1946, we've worked to challenge the status quo, break down barriers, and build a more equitable future. With bold commitments- including becoming net-zero by 2040 across all mortgages and loans-we are championing financial resilience, climate action, and belonging for our members and communities. As the largest private sector Living Wage Employer in Canada and home to a team of 2,300 passionate employees, Vancity offers competitive rewards and benefits, diverse career pathways, and the opportunity to be part of something bigger. The Opportunity: We're seeking an intern to join our Visa team for a four?month opportunity. The Visa team supports risk and analytics activities for Vancity's Visa credit card portfolio, playing a key role in managing account originations and developing credit strategies for both Retail and Business Visa products. This role will report to a Manager within the Visa Risk and Analytics team and offers hands?on exposure to data?driven decision?making in a dynamic financial services environment. A typical day would involve: • Supporting day-to-day data activities related to Visa Risk and Analytics by gathering, cleaning, validating, and organizing data from multiple sources • Using Excel, SQL and other tools to manipulate data, investigate data quality, and support analytical activities • Assisting with analyzing trends, preparing insights and to support decision making within the Visa team • Creating spreadsheets, presentations, and documentation to support analysts and managers • Collaborating with Visa Planning & Settlement, Payments Operations, and Risk & Analytics partners on assigned tasks and projects What You'll Earn: This role offers a pay range of $27.85/hr. Application Details: Please submit your resume. Cover letters and transcripts are optional but appreciated. Job Requirements You are: • Customer-Centric - You define and measure success through the eyes of your internal customers and anticipate, understand, and respond to their evolving needs. Demonstrate strong follow-through: Consistently keep commitments to customers and team members. • Results-Oriented - You have a demonstrated ability to engage stakeholders to elicit requirements gathering, analyze findings, generate appropriate solutions, and build deliverables all while securing team's commitment to these solutions. • Technology Savvy - You have education and/or experience supporting technology development/ implementation efforts. • A Critical Thinker - You seek to facilitate data-driven decision making, including "rolling up your sleeves" to elicit requirements, research, analyze data • A Problem Solver - Your skills to diagnose challenges and issues, develop innovative business solutions, and assess risks and opportunities that may affect the business, are showcased on a daily basis. • Curious & innovative - You always do your research and analyze it to assess and recommend a course of action considering industry best practices • A team player - you can engage with members of your team as well as cross-functional teams and are willing to collaborate across projects and initiatives. You have: • Current enrollment in an undergraduate program within an applicable field and eligible for co-op/internship opportunities • An interest in data analysis, analytics and financial services • A willingness to work in a highly flexible environment with multiple competing priorities. • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills A high level of attention to detail • Bonus points, if you have: • Experience with SQL or data querying • Exposure to Python, R, or SAS • Familiarity with financial or operational data sets Prior coursework or experience in analytics, data science • Citizenship Requirement N/A APPLICATION INFORMATION Application Procedure Through Employer Website Cover Letter Required?
